title: Plan the change for people, not just systems
summary: New systems fail when people do not change how they work. Plan how people will learn about, want, learn and keep using the new way.

beginner: List the groups affected and how their work will change.
Explain why the change is happening, early and often.
Find champions in each group to help others.
Provide training and help at the moment people need it.
Check how people are getting on and fix problems quickly.
Remove the old way once the new way works.
intermediate: Track adoption and reinforce the change.
experienced: Use a change model to find where people are stuck.
Measure behaviour change, not training attendance.

toolExamples.sharepoint-word: Publish guides where staff already look.
toolExamples.confluence: Keep a change plan with groups, messages and dates.

pitfalls: Keeping the old way available forever
